## What changes

Describe the problem, the smallest useful change, and the affected review checkpoint. If it changes a lesson, state the learning demand.

## Verification

- Branch/commit reviewed:
- Automated checks run and their results:
- Real-browser/device checks run, including environment:
- Not yet verified:

## Review checklist

- [ ] The target branch is the appropriate stacked review checkpoint.
- [ ] Behavior changes have a focused regression, or the reason one is not applicable is explained.
- [ ] Learner drafts, progression, Undo, backups, and recovery messages remain trustworthy.
- [ ] The focused interface, keyboard/flat-map path, reduced motion, and offline design are preserved where affected.
- [ ] No real learner data, private journals, credentials, browser profiles, or generated delivery output are included.
- [ ] New code/assets have clear provenance; existing third-party notices are preserved.
- [ ] Documentation describes observed evidence accurately and does not claim learning, browser, or device validation from simulations.

## Evidence or follow-up

Link the issue and any relevant synthetic reproduction. Label screenshots as direct observations and name the actual device; list remaining acceptance work without treating it as passed.
